name: absent-person
description: An invitee is off sick and talked about throughout; someone covers her update.
lines: Before we start, has anyone heard from Siobhan? She was meant to give the hiring update.
She messaged me, she's off sick today, so I'll cover it.
So both offers went out on Monday. One is accepted, the other candidate wants a later start date, and Siobhan thinks that's fine.
Okay. Anything else on hiring? No? Then let's do the budget. I've got the numbers here.
Can you share the sheet in the chat?
